findings.note: NBA.com player news says Murray-Boyles started Monday (Nov 2) against the Clippers. His last five PRA totals were 18, 25, 8, 21 and 13, so he cleared 19.5 twice, including in that start. A continued starting role is the main risk to the Under.

RotoWire via CBS (Oct 20) projected him as one of the first men off the bench who would likely start if Kawhi Leonard or Jakob Poeltl missed time. Their status for Milwaukee was not confirmed, and that drives his minutes.

ESPN lists 2026-27 averages of 9.6 points, 4.8 rebounds and 1.3 assists in 20.6 minutes over 8 games, about 15.7 PRA. His career PRA is about 15.4 in 21.7 minutes, both well below 19.5. He scored 18 PRA in 23 minutes at Denver on Nov 4.
